content: Lipgloss v2 (charm.land/lipgloss/v2) is the companion styling library for Bubbletea. Released Feb 2026 alongside bubbletea v2. v1.1.0 was published Mar 2025; v2 is now the highest tagged major version. Features: CSS-like styling API with Bold/Italic/Foreground/Background/Padding/Margin; JoinHorizontal() and JoinVertical() for side-by-side layouts; Place() for positioning; multiple border styles (Rounded, Normal, Double, Thick); AdaptiveColor for light/dark themes; automatic color profile downsampling built-in in v2; Table/List/Tree sub-packages. Used by 9,630+ packages.
